caseName: Raphael v. Wasatch & Jordan Valley Railroad
caseNameFull: Russell Sage Raphael v. The Wasatch & Jordan Valley Railroad Company
summary: Appeal from the United States Circuit Court of Appeals for the Eighth Circuit.
attorneys: Mr. Delos McCurdy and Mr. Thomas Bracken for the appellant. Mr. Joel F. Vaile, Mr. Waldemar Van Cott, Mr. E. M. Allison, Jr., Mr. Henry McAllister, Jr., and Mr. William D. Riter for the appellees.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Dismissed for the want of jurisdiction on the authority of Bagley v. General Fire Extinguisher Co., 212 U. S. 477, 479; Weir v. Rountree, 216 U. S. 607; Shulthis v. McDougal, 225 U. S. 561, 569.
